subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should persistent Gateway clients gain an additive per-request cancellation/deadline protocol so the server receives the caller's authoritative lifetime?
rationale: The current caller timeout is local, while the branch's server-inferred approval deadline neither closes the vulnerability window nor safely defines mixed-version and long-running request behavior.

options.title: Add authoritative cancellation
options.body: Negotiate or propagate the actual request deadline or cancel event, bind it to the originating connection, and permit cancellation only before node dispatch begins.

options.title: Accept disconnect-only hardening
options.body: Narrow this PR to socket-close cancellation and leave caller-local timeout cancellation to separately tracked protocol work.

options.title: Define a server timeout
options.body: Choose and document a universal server-owned deadline with explicit compatibility and availability acceptance.

recommendation.title: Add authoritative cancellation
recommendation.body: Negotiate or propagate the actual request deadline or cancel event, bind it to the originating connection, and permit cancellation only before node dispatch begins.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue specifies the required Gateway security contract, and steipete has the strongest available lifecycle ownership signal.
